Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Elevated 5xx/timeouts observed in inference-gateway-prod starting ~1779997400. Error rate increased from ~0.15% -> ~5.8%. Alerting on-call.
Amanda SRE: I'm taking this one. Looking at traces and logs now — a lot of model-runner exits with segfault and OOM patterns across two availability zones.
Amanda SRE: High level: gateway 5xxs are largely 502/503 proxies failing when upstream model-runner returns connection errors. Model-runner logs show crashbacks referencing libinference_kernel and attention kernel allocation failures.
Kevin R.: Taking pager for next 45m. Amanda, paste current debugging steps here before I switch to active.
Amanda SRE: Notes before handoff: anomaly began after a canary change around 1779997000 that toggled "fused_attention_longseq" on. Crash signature: SIGSEGV in kernel_dispatch.c at frame calling cuda_allocator_map with invalid pointer.
Amanda SRE: Sample log snippet: ```
E Mar 15 10:40:12 model-runner[pid=4310]: signal 11 (Segmentation fault) at 0x7f2c9b4d2f4a in libinference_kernel.so (kernel_dispatch.c:412)
Backtrace: /usr/lib/libinference_kernel.so+0x12f4a
```
Julia (ML): That aligns with the new fused-attention path. We had limited canary data for sequences > 1500 tokens. Looks like a heap-use-after-free or out-of-bounds when computing windowed attention states.
Priya (Ops Lead): Customer impact? Ben, any support tickets or escalations?
Ben (Support): Two customers filing issues: AcmePayments (high-priority, fintech) seeing increased latency then 5xx; EduAI Labs reporting intermittent timeouts. I've opened tickets and linked this thread.
Amanda SRE: Immediate mitigations applied: 1) Feature-flagged fused_attention_longseq=false via config service; 2) Added traffic rule to route requests with tokens>1024 to stable model variant redwood/3b-stable; 3) Increased model-runner replicas by 25% in a third region to reduce pressure.
Kevin R.: I'll perform a targeted rolling restart of model-runner pods that still have the old kernel mapped. Command: `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/model-runner --field-selector='status.phase==Running'` Will coordinate drain of noisy nodes.
Incident Bot: Deploybot: rollout initiated for deployment/model-runner @ 1779997895 by Kevin R.
Amanda SRE: After flag flip and partial restart, 5xx dropped from 5.8% -> 1.9%. Some residual failures tied to pods still on the old binary and a couple of driver warnings on GPU hosts.
Kevin R.: Identified two problematic nodes: gpu-host-azb-09 and gpu-host-aza-04. Planning `kubectl drain` one at a time to force eviction and restart the runtime.
Priya (Ops Lead): Approved. Schedule drains staggered by 3m and ensure fallback routing in gateway for affected endpoints during drain. Notify support to tell impacted customers.
Amanda SRE: Drain started on gpu-host-azb-09. Node logs show repeated OOM kills around model-runner pids and NVidia driver WARN: GPU context lost, followed by segfaults in libinference_kernel.
Julia (ML): Action items for model/runtime teams: revert fused-attention long-sequence opt, add bounds-checking and ASAN-like instrumentation in debug builds, extend canary test to include long-context workloads. I'll open a PR with revert + test harness.
Ben (Support): Outreach: Notified AcmePayments & EduAI with mitigation steps and ETA ~20-40m for full stabilization. Requesting request traces and sample payloads for further triage.
Kevin R.: After drains and full rollout, metrics show 5xx down to 0.4% and median latencies normalized. Keeping monitoring window open for 60m.
Amanda SRE: Post-mitigation summary: probable root cause = memory corruption in new fused-attention kernel when handling long sequences, causing segfaults and cascading OOMs. Mitigations = feature-flag revert, targeted rollout, node drains, and traffic fallback.
Priya (Ops Lead): Remediation plan: 1) Amanda to own incident writeup + timeline, 2) Julia to own kernel revert and safe patch with extended long-seq canary, 3) infra QA to add automated long-seq load tests in CI, 4) Ben to follow up with customers and coordinate any credits/SLA touches.
Kevin R.: I'll remain on-thread for 30 more minutes. Great coordination. :thumbsup:
Amanda SRE: I'll prepare timeline and metric graphs, and mark the pager for clear once stable for 30m.
Oncall Pager: Pager cleared at 1779998090 (monitoring only).
Incident Bot: Incident INC-177999 created and linked to this thread.
